newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki stays near new highs with bulls unabated.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki stays near new highs with bulls unabated.

text.p: Afternoon trade eased after a hectic morning but shares stayed near early records as Raisio and Nokia encouraged bulls into other issues, brokers said.
Holding group Finvest jumped almost 15 percent in relatively lively trade and the A share added 20 percent, after the group said it was considering listing its engineering company Jaakko Poyry.
OKOBANK took strength from Merita's recent gains, although some of the trades were crossed in-house at its brokerage Opstock, brokers said.
The market was eyeing reactions to U.S. June housing starts, which are forecast on average at 1.5 million, and brokers expected the pace of trade to pick up towards to U.S. open.
"It was crazy in the morning, it is easier now, but I'm sure the rhumba will soon start again," one broker said.
The Standard & Poors September 7 futures SPU7) contract traded at 942.95, up 0.65 points just ahead of the housing starts data.
